shortDescription: Soda City Serenade performs live while you play Four Dogs Music Bingo at Charter 803.
description: Experience a lively twist on Music Bingo at Charter 803. Soda City Serenade performs live while you follow along on your bingo card, listen for familiar tunes, and mark your matches. There are multiple chances to win prizes, with food and drinks available for purchase from Charter 803. Bring your friends for a night of live music and friendly competition.
